subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept this folder-backed encrypted snapshot and restore flow as first-party core backup scope once the safety blockers and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The PR adds public CLI commands, a new openclaw.json config section, encrypted state/credential restore behavior, and destructive filesystem operations, so the permanent scope and safety bar need maintainer intent beyond mechanical fixes.

options.title: Continue Scoped Native Backup
options.body: Fix the blockers, require real CLI proof, then review the rebased branch as the local encrypted snapshot subset of the native backup lifecycle.

options.title: Limit Core To Local Archives
options.body: Keep core focused on create/verify while folder-backed cloud-drive style snapshots move to a plugin or ClawHub package.

options.title: Pause For Backup Design
options.body: Pause this branch until the canonical backup issue settles component restore, credentials, sessions, and cloud/encryption policy.

recommendation.title: Continue Scoped Native Backup
recommendation.body: Fix the blockers, require real CLI proof, then review the rebased branch as the local encrypted snapshot subset of the native backup lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical backup umbrella already has product/security routing from this account, and recent backup-area history makes this the best observed decision owner.
